# Delegated.watch

> Account-wide record of AI work delegated to models, across every provider, surface, and machine. Token-denominated, person-scoped, static.

Delegated.watch is a static dashboard over one JSON file. It counts inference
requests and tokens for delegated AI work across providers, interaction
surfaces, and machines, including local inference. Raw logs never enter the
repository; only scrubbed aggregates are committed.

The published page at https://delegated.watch/ carries synthetic demonstration
data, not a record of anyone's actual usage.

## Pages
- [Dashboard](https://delegated.watch/): the served page.

## Source
- [Repository](https://github.com/snapsynapse/delegated-watch): scripts, data contract, and evaluation harness.
- [Data contract](https://github.com/snapsynapse/delegated-watch/blob/main/DATA_CONTRACT.md): the shape and fidelity rules every source entry obeys.
- [Intent](https://github.com/snapsynapse/delegated-watch/blob/main/INTENT.md): design invariants and scope boundaries.
- [Privacy](https://github.com/snapsynapse/delegated-watch/blob/main/PRIVACY.md): what is and is not published.

## Notes
- No sitemap.xml. The site is a single page; the sitemap would restate the
  canonical URL and nothing else.
